welle_e4.zeitung.bericht_fakt: Official impact review {monate} months after the decision “{name}”: from {von} to {auf}.{zusatz}
welle_e4.zeitung.bericht_fakt_ohne: Official impact review {monate} months after the decision “{name}”.{zusatz}
welle_e4.bedingung.text.buendnis: Washington will release the next tranche of “{name}” only if Ankara makes a commitment within the Alliance. In January 2024 the F-16 deal came only after parliament had ratified Sweden's NATO accession.
welle_e4.bedingung.text.rechte: Berlin is holding back the export licence for parts of “{name}” and wants a commitment on the Eastern Mediterranean and on fundamental rights. Every consortium partner must agree; Germany gave its consent to the Eurofighter only on 23 July 2025.
welle_e4.bedingung.warum.buendnis: Anything from the United States needs an export licence, and Congress uses it as leverage.
welle_e4.bedingung.warum.rechte: A joint programme delivers only if every partner state agrees.
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.nachgeben.buendni: Make the commitment to the Alliance
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.nachgeben.rechte: Give the commitment on the Eastern Mediterranean and rights
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.nachgeben.ausgang: Ankara gives {land} the commitment. Delivery of “{name}” continues.
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.heimisch.label: Build the parts at home
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.heimisch.ausgang: Domestic industry takes over the parts for “{name}”; the programme loses about {monate} months.
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.ablehnen.label: Reject the condition
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.ablehnen.beschr: {land} withholds the parts: about {monate} months of delay, relations cool.
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.ablehnen.ausgang: Ankara rejects the condition. {land} withholds the parts for “{name}”; about {monate} months of delay.
welle_e4.bedingung.standard: With no answer from Ankara the licence stays pending. “{name}” loses about {monate} months, and {land} reads the silence as a refusal.
welle_e4.export.titel.kaan: {land} wants to buy KAAN fighter jets
welle_e4.export.titel.drohnen: {land} wants to buy Turkish combat drones
welle_e4.export.text.kaan: {land} is asking for a batch of KAAN. Indonesia signed a contract for 48 in July 2025.
welle_e4.export.text.drohnen: {land} is asking for Bayraktar TB2 and Akıncı. Turkish combat drones have gone to dozens of countries; defence exports reached about 10 billion dollars in 2025.
welle_e4.export.gegner: {gegner} sees the delivery as taking sides with {land}.
welle_e4.export.ohneGegner: None of the buyer's neighbours is in a dispute with it.
welle_e4.export.warum: Exports carry the defence industry: orders, jobs and hard currency. But every delivery is also foreign policy.
welle_e4.export.opt.liefern.label: Deliver
welle_e4.export.opt.liefern.ausgang: The contract with {land} is signed. The plants report full order books.
welle_e4.export.opt.auflage.label: Deliver with end-use conditions
welle_e4.export.opt.auflage.ausgang: {land} receives the delivery with conditions on its use. The deal is smaller, and so is the anger.
welle_e4.export.opt.ablehnen.label: Decline
welle_e4.export.standard: With no answer, {land} buys elsewhere and remembers it.
welle_e4.verzug.grund.triebwerk: “{name}” is waiting for the F110 engines from the United States: the licence came in July 2026, and deliveries from 2027 depend on General Electric's schedule.
welle_e4.verzug.grund.antrieb: “{name}” is waiting for its powerpack: the German embargo stopped the MTU and Renk engine, the Korean replacement came only in 2021, and the domestic BATU engine is still being tested.
welle_e4.verzug.grund.zustimmung: “{name}” is waiting for the export licence of a consortium partner; without every approval the programme does not deliver.
welle_e4.verzug.grund.vorprodukte: “{name}” is short of inputs: steel, electronics and components are not arriving in the quantities ordered.
welle_e4.verzug.grund.erprobung: Testing of “{name}” is taking longer: acceptance is postponed until the defects are fixed.
welle_e4.plattform.titel: {plattform} refuses to comply with a blocking order
welle_e4.plattform.text1: The Information and Communication Technologies Authority has ordered accounts to be removed. {plattform} refuses, citing freedom of expression.
welle_e4.plattform.text2: Otherwise the platform complies with {quote}% of such orders. Law 7253 allows its bandwidth to be throttled by up to 90%.
welle_e4.plattform.warum: If orders are not enforced, authority suffers. A block hits millions of users and the merchants who sell there.
welle_e4.plattform.opt.sperren.label: Block {plattform}
welle_e4.plattform.opt.sperren.ausgang: {plattform} is blocked, as Instagram was in August 2024. The number of VPN users rises.
welle_e4.plattform.opt.drosseln.label: Throttle the bandwidth
welle_e4.plattform.opt.drosseln.ausgang: The authority throttles {plattform} under Law 7253. Images and videos barely load.
welle_e4.plattform.opt.nachgeben.label: Withdraw the order
welle_e4.plattform.opt.nachgeben.ausgang: The order against {plattform} is withdrawn. The government's own supporters call it weakness.
welle_e4.plattform.standard: Without instructions the authority throttles {plattform} on its own. The president stays out of sight.
welle_e4.enthuellung.text.stammfirma: {blatt} publishes documents: the contract for “{vorhaben}” went without a tender to a company close to the government.
welle_e4.enthuellung.text.allgemein: {blatt} reports irregularities in the contracts for “{vorhaben}”: prices above market and unexplained change orders.
welle_e4.enthuellung.warum: A revelation about money hits credibility. Silence confirms it.
welle_e4.enthuellung.gescheitert: The response did not happen ({grund}). The story takes full effect.
welle_e4.enthuellung.opt.pruefen.label: Have the Court of Accounts investigate
welle_e4.enthuellung.opt.pruefen.ausgang: The Court of Accounts examines the contract for “{vorhaben}”; it is put out to tender again.
welle_e4.enthuellung.opt.verfahren.label: Bring in the broadcasting regulator against {blatt}
Open proceedings against {blatt}
welle_e4.enthuellung.standard: The government stays silent on “{vorhaben}”. {blatt} follows up and gains readers.
welle_e4.sendezeit.titel.praesident: Airtime in the campaign: how will state television report?
welle_e4.sendezeit.titel.kommunal: Airtime before the local elections: how will state television report?
welle_e4.sendezeit.text1: The management of state broadcasting asks the Presidency how airtime should be allocated.
welle_e4.sendezeit.text2: In 2023 TRT 1 and TRT Haber gave the incumbent's camp 44 to 45% of political coverage and the challenger 25 to 28%. OSCE election observers criticised this.
welle_e4.sendezeit.warum: State broadcasting reaches mainly older and rural voters. Nobody has measured how many votes airtime brings.
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.linie.label: Government line as in 2023
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.linie.ausgang: State broadcasting reports mostly on the government. Election observers take note.
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.ausgewogen.label: Equal airtime for all camps
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.ausgewogen.ausgan: State broadcasting divides airtime equally. The opposition is surprised, Brussels is full of praise.
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.allesender.label: Interview on every channel at once
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.allesender.ausgan: The interview runs on almost every channel at once, as it did on 29 channels in 2023.
welle_e4.sendezeit.standard: Without instructions state broadcasting follows habit and reports mostly on the government.
welle_e4.lieferung.ausgang: The armed forces take over {menge} from “{name}”.
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.nachgeben.beschr: The delivery continues and {land} trusts Ankara more.
welle_e4.bedingung.opt.heimisch.beschr: More expensive and about {monate} months later, but more independent.
welle_e4.export.folge.auflage: Use only under conditions, a smaller deal.
welle_e4.plattform.opt.sperren.beschr: Like Instagram from 2 to 10 August 2024. Many switch to VPNs.
welle_e4.plattform.opt.drosseln.beschr: Under Law 7253, up to 90% less bandwidth. Milder than a block.
welle_e4.plattform.opt.nachgeben.beschr: The content stays online. Your own camp calls it weakness.
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.linie.beschr: As in 2023: about 45% of coverage for your own camp.
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.ausgewogen.beschr: Equal airtime for every camp; election observers praise it.
welle_e4.sendezeit.opt.allesender.beschr: As on 29 channels at once in 2023. Strong with your own camp, costly abroad.
welle_e4.enthuellung.opt.pruefen.beschr: The tender is held after the fact; construction pauses for about {monate} months.
